title: Loams Unified Plugin Manifest
description: JSON Schema for Loams plugins, unifying backend plugins and web console plugins.

name.description: Plugin metadata: The unique name or id of the plugin (e.g. '@loams/plugin-shell' or 'loams').

version.description: Plugin metadata: The semantic version of the plugin.

description.description: Plugin metadata: Description of what the plugin does.

author.description: Plugin metadata: Author of the plugin.

layer.description: Layer declaration: Which architectural layer this plugin belongs to.

entry.description: Entry points: ESM entry for the plugin package.

inject.description: Dependencies: Services this plugin requires to be injected.

provides.description: Dependencies: Services this plugin provides to others.

requires.description: Dependencies: External requirements like API packages or console version.

console.description: Semver requirement for the console host.

permissions.description: Permissions and scopes: Permissions required by the plugin in the UI.

requiredScopes.description: Permissions and scopes: Auth scopes a caller must hold before this plugin's routes or skills answer.

slots.description: Slot registrations: UI slots registered by this plugin.

editions.description: Edition membership: The editions this plugin is a member of.

agent.description: Agent block if this plugin contributes A2A agent skills.

actions.description: The action names this plugin may register in the actions registry.

uiPath.description: Route the plugin's own UI is served at, e.g. '/plugins/loams'.

alwaysOn.description: If true, the console toggle is disabled and the plugin is never unloaded.

order.description: Console sort key. Lower sorts first. Defaults to 100.

defaultEnabled.description: Enabled state for a plugin that has never been toggled before.
